description: Core payload families of profile 2.0 (Hub #842 and #918). `valid` holds at least one message for every family and every message kind they use. Each invalid case copies a valid message and sets the JSON pointers in `set`; null removes the member. `detail` pins where it fails. Each scenario applies valid messages in order to the reference consumer copy in tests/consumer.mjs and names the messages whose payloads remain. The root session's state, occurrence and removal messages are what the real owner published in one reference history, which apps/runtime/tests/reference-history.test.ts replays (Hub #831). Only those messages come from it: the Claude session, inbox item and sync fixtures keep revisions of their own, chosen for the consumer rules they show, so `sync-completed` at revisions 14 and 15 still lists the root session that the reference history retires at 12. A finished turn is never an inbox item (Hub #782 removed the turn-ended item), so the inbox items are operations only.
